rules.submissionFormat: worker-specific uniquely named Markdown/JSONL/CSV under research/coordination/submissions/<worker>/; include source URLs, original data, field confidence, tests, blockers, exact keys
rules.masterWrites: research/coordination/assignments.json and central ledgers; workers must not overwrite these
rules.confidenceGate: PROVISIONAL_BELOW_90_ALLOWED_WITH_FIELD_PROVENANCE; full four-field numeric and exhaustive universe audit tracked separately
rules.overflow: Only master may reassign completed worker to other expansion after independent QA; no self-claim or cross-scope duplication
rules.unmappedSourceOutputs: Worker must preserve unlabeled output vectors without assigning item IDs or awarding first-pass coverage; only independently verified mapping can promote to candidate output records.
rules.schemaGate: Observation JSONL must pass status and mapped-or-unmapped nonempty evidence checks before central acceptance.
rules.workerUnmappedIndexPolicy: Keep unmapped output vectors raw; no invented IDs or first-pass credit for unassigned index values
rules.rawEvidenceGate: Raw JSONL must match observation.schema.json; derived ore-equivalent operations are NOT completedOperations. Worker batch001 immutable originals may be quarantined while first-pass coverage is accepted.
rules.orderedOverflow: Prioritize home-expansion exact numeric field gaps; after home gaps exhausted, master assigns disjoint Dragonflight overflow; do not call gap revisits first-pass coverage
rules.numericMechanicsHypotheses: Workers handle one explicitly assigned mechanism from mechanicsTrack and do not count hypothesis examination as newly covered item/output record. Master QA approves promotion only after independent source and test review.
rules.tooltipFallbackPolicy: PROVISIONAL_DISPLAY_ONLY; source-backed zero-inclusive completed-cast P required; conservative positive min/max may be shown only for exact supported input/output/rank; never feed gold EV or overwrite stronger fields
rules.economicExpectedQuantityPolicy: ONLY_CURRENT_APPLICABLE_INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED_PER_COMPLETED_OPERATION_E_IS_GOLD_ELIGIBLE; historical TSM proxies remain research-only; never multiply E by P
